name: lazy-man-dev
description: One skill you call. It routes the task, dispatches sub-agents, and refuses to hand back more code than the job needed.
_type: Node resolves module kind from the NEAREST package.json above a file. Without this one, cloning lazy-man-dev inside a project whose package.json says "type": "module" makes Node treat these CommonJS scripts as ESM and `require` explodes. This pins the whole repo to CommonJS regardless of where it is cloned.
